grasp_verify/held: cup held, arm still in the Verify pose (normal room light)
cup held a little crooked / gripped higher or lower than usual
cup held, a different yogurt flavour or label side facing the camera
cup held, lights dimmer or a shadow across the table
cup held, cluttered background (other objects on the table)
cup held, people moving in the background
grasp_verify/empty: gripper closed on nothing, cup still on the table in view
gripper closed on nothing, no cup in view
empty gripper, cluttered table, other cups or mugs in view
empty gripper, lights dimmer or a shadow across the table
empty gripper, a hand or arm passing through the picture
handoff_grab/grabbed: one hand wrapped firmly around the cup, from the front
hand holding the cup from the left, then from the right
hand holding the cup from above (fingers over the lid) and from below
different people: large and small hands, sleeves, a watch, a glove if likely
holding and gently pulling, as someone impatient would
handoff_grab/not_grabbed: a hand approaching but not touching yet
a hand hovering right next to the cup, fingers open
fingers touching or tapping the cup without gripping it
people walking past and gesturing in the background
a face close to the camera, looking at the cup
yogurt_detection/images: cup on the table at many distances and positions while the arm sweeps left to right in the survey pose
cup rotated: every side of the label, lid towards and away from the camera
cup near the edges of the picture (the wide lens stretches it there)
other flavours / brands of yogurt you may use at the demo
cluttered table: mugs, bottles, bowls next to the cup (these teach it what is NOT yogurt)
no cup at all: empty table and clutter only (label these 'No yogurt')
different lighting, and the venue where the demo will be if you can
